parameters.name: From
parameters.description: The source identifier of the request. Set this parameter to sas.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:
- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The IP address of the access source.

parameters.name: Uuids
parameters.description:
The UUID of the server. Separate multiple UUIDs with commas (,).
> Call the [DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~141932~~) operation to obtain this parameter.
